# Definition of Done

A change is done only when:

- [ ] It solves the intended problem.
- [ ] Backend validates untrusted input.
- [ ] Resource-level authorization is correct.
- [ ] Tests cover valuable behavior.
- [ ] Public API/error contracts are stable.
- [ ] Database constraints/migrations are safe.
- [ ] Logs/metrics/traces are sufficient for the risk.
- [ ] Docs/env examples are updated.
- [ ] No secrets/private data are committed.
- [ ] Rollback/deploy impact is understood.
